arStrings.szText:
While at least {c_number}1{/c} enemy is afflicted with {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c}, you gain {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} Thorns.

{c_important}Iron Maiden's{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100]%{/c} of your Thorns.

{c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} is also a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage. 

Enemies have {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} chance to be stunned for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds when they take damage from {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c}.

{c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} is also a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u}. 

Casting {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} picks up {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} {c_important}{u}Blood Orbs{/c}{/u} in the target area and causes them to burst for {c_number}{payload:BLOOD_EXPLOSION}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c}.

Enemies afflicted with {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} will be {c_important}{u}Executed{/c}{/u}.

You are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_7}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} when an enemy dies while afflicted with {c_important}Iron Maiden.{/c}

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Enemies hit while afflicted with {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} have up to a {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c} chance to randomly grant {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u} or {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}.
